div.span: Undo all also runs when the rule is disabled or paused, another profile is chosen, the context turns false or the app comes to the front. A process that joins while Acting gets the steps already taken. Steps are LowerPriority, EfficiencyMode, CpuCap(percent) and Notify; Notify has no inverse.

text.tspan: Undo all also runs when the rule is disabled or paused, another profile is chosen, the context turns false or the app comes to the front. A process that joins while Acting gets the steps already taken. Steps are LowerPriority,
EfficiencyMode, CpuCap(percent) and Notify; Notify has no inverse.
